resolved_review_findings.resolution: The typed sentiment_features slot now derives model availability and model status from eligible FinBERT/VADER contributions and the validated fusion result, records provenance only for available components, and propagates the selected attempt's explicit quality and coverage state. Partial aggregates remain usable but any required-model failure, fusion failure, unknown/failed selected-attempt quality, or low/unknown coverage marks the slot degraded. Explicitly failed model chunks are excluded even if stale chunk payloads are present.

typed_feature_status_contract.provenance_rule: model_versions contains only model components that contributed valid eligible data, while compact model_statuses preserves validated FinBERT, VADER, fusion, and selected-attempt status.
typed_feature_status_contract.partial_aggregate_rule: An aggregate may remain non-null when one model or fusion fails, but missing/degraded flags and availability must make the partial or failed state explicit.
typed_feature_status_contract.coverage_rule: Selected-attempt quality_passed and retrieval unique-document/domain coverage are propagated before Shared State commit; low or unknown coverage cannot appear healthy.
